statement: My research spans **spatial foundation models** and **embodied AI**, from efficient 3D reconstruction to agents for household robot tasks. More broadly, I'm interested in **computer vision** and **world models**, especially generative, interactive world models for games.

publications.title: GeoHalt: Adaptive Token Halting for Efficient Visual Geometry Transformers
publications.tldr: Learns when each image patch can stop updating, making visual geometry transformers **up to 2.16× faster**.

publications.title: Scaling by Structure: What Forms Can Scaling Take in Embodied AI?
authors: Team “The North Star”, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
publications.tldr: A frozen VLM coding agent that builds robot pipelines. **Ranked 1st** on all 100 BEHAVIOR-1K tasks.
